output.summary: A member of the carrot family native to western Europe, it bears frilly leaves and a small rounded taproot. The root, once used as a vegetable in parts of western Europe, is edible raw or cooked, while the leaves can serve as an herb or garnish.
output.edibilityNote: The taproot is edible raw or cooked and was formerly a western European root vegetable; leaves can be used as an herb or garnish.
